title: Quantifying Teleportation Overhead in Distributed Unitary Coupled-Cluster Ansätze
summary: Distributed quantum computing (DQC) has been proposed as a way to scale quantum algorithms for practical applications beyond monolithic quantum processor architectures. Among these applications, quantum chemistry is widely regarded as one of the most promising use cases for quantum computing.
